panels.title: Topology — link load (drag the time slider to replay)
panels.description: Weathermap of the clab topology. Link stroke colour and label follow the outbound bit rate of the router-side interface. Use the $bucket dropdown to switch granularity tier and the built-in time slider to scrub through history — this is the DigSiViz time machine.

options.panelConfig:
---
# GENERATED by grafana/flow/generate_flow.py - do not edit by hand.
# Maps SVG cell ids to query series names. The series name is produced by
# the panel's Flux query via pivot(), which turns each series into its own
# named column (Grafana names fields after columns).

anchors:
  thresholds-traffic: &thresholds-traffic
      - color: "#bec8d2"
        level: 0
      - color: "#4BDD33"
        level: 100000
      - color: "#FFFF00"
        level: 1000000
      - color: "#FF8000"
        level: 10000000
      - color: "#FF3154"
        level: 50000000
  label-config: &label-config
    separator: replace
    units: bps
    decimalPoints: 1

cellIdPreamble: "cell-"

cells:
  link_id:r1:ethernet-1/1:r2:ethernet-1/1:
    dataRef: "r1:ethernet-1/1:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
  link_id:r2:ethernet-1/1:r1:ethernet-1/1:
    dataRef: "r2:ethernet-1/1:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
  link_id:r1:ethernet-1/2:r3:ethernet-1/1:
    dataRef: "r1:ethernet-1/2:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
  link_id:r3:ethernet-1/1:r1:ethernet-1/2:
    dataRef: "r3:ethernet-1/1:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
  link_id:r2:ethernet-1/2:r3:ethernet-1/2:
    dataRef: "r2:ethernet-1/2:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
  link_id:r3:ethernet-1/2:r2:ethernet-1/2:
    dataRef: "r3:ethernet-1/2:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
  link_id:r1:ethernet-1/3:h1:eth1:
    dataRef: "r1:ethernet-1/3:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
  link_id:r2:ethernet-1/3:h2:eth1:
    dataRef: "r2:ethernet-1/3:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic
  link_id:r3:ethernet-1/3:h3:eth1:
    dataRef: "r3:ethernet-1/3:out"
    label: *label-config
    strokeColor:
      thresholds: *thresholds-traffic

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_interface")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "statistics_out-octets" or r._field == "statistics_out-octets_mean")
  |> group(columns: ["hostname", "interface_name"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 8.0,
                      name: r.hostname + ":" + r.interface_name + ":out"}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["name"], valueColumn: "_value")
